candidates.name: Grab
candidates.description: Grab is a transportation and retail service that offers various payment options, including Grab vouchers, car loans, and bike rentals. Its main functionality includes providing convenient payment methods, enabling users to easily pay for services without cash or credit cards. The platform also features promotional programs, such as the MLBBB challenge where users can purchase data packages and earn rewards through its Grabs Package program. Additionally, Grab supports drivers with financial solutions and innovative technology tools to enhance their business operations and customer experiences.
candidates.rationale: The unrelated cabinetry domain and mixed social profiles indicate a misattributed duplicate of Grab, not a distinct lookalike company.

candidates.name: 2C2P
candidates.description: 2C2P is a payment platform that provides secure and efficient solutions for businesses in Southeast Asia. It offers a range of services including payment acceptance for airlines, social commerce, customizable wallets, and payment processing for both individual and business customers. The platform supports over 600,000 locations across the region, simplifying complex settlements and making payments more accessible to underserved populations.
candidates.rationale: Both provide Southeast Asian merchants with digital payment acceptance, wallet, processing, and settlement services for the same commerce payment needs.

candidates.name: 3Efreet
candidates.description: 3Efreet is a delivery service that offers various options for both individuals and businesses. Users can book deliveries through the 3Efaire app, which allows them to compare prices and select package sizes tailored to their needs. The platform supports all types of delivery vehicles, including bikes and scooter riders, and provides services like courier pickup and drop-off in Dubai. Additionally, it features a dedicated section for delivery partners to enhance their income by expanding their delivery services.
candidates.rationale: 3Efreet’s app-based, on-demand courier marketplace overlaps Grab’s delivery services and serves individuals and businesses needing local pickup and drop-off.

candidates.name: Deliveryforyou
candidates.description: Deliveryforyou is a delivery platform that offers tailored solutions for various businesses, including restaurants, supermarkets, and e-commerce. Its main functionality includes providing real-time tracking of delivery status, customizable deliveries based on customer preferences, and efficient logistics management. Key features include fast and flexible delivery options, competitive pricing, and customer support to enhance the overall experience for both businesses and their customers.
candidates.rationale: Both provide delivery platforms for merchants, with restaurants and retailers potentially evaluating either for last-mile delivery and logistics management.

candidates.name: USER
candidates.description: E-Gift Card is an online platform that offers a variety of digital gift cards for purchase across multiple categories including fashion, food, groceries, travel, and entertainment. Users can browse and select gift cards from popular brands, redeem them using reward points or cash, and receive their digital gift card delivered via email/SMS. The service also provides discounts on various products and allows users to download the app for additional savings and promotions.
candidates.rationale: USER is a digital gift-card marketplace, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app serving the same job to be done.

candidates.name: Grabit
candidates.description: Grabit is a travel and delivery app that allows users to book rides, send parcels, and shop for local stores through a single platform. Users can choose from various payment options and track their riders or drivers in real-time. The app also offers loyalty points that can be redeemed for rewards, enabling users to earn points on every ride and delivery. Additionally, Grabit provides opportunities for drivers to become part of the community while offering flexible earnings and support for both riders and merchants.
candidates.rationale: Grabit similarly combines on-demand ride-hailing, parcel delivery, local shopping, payments, and merchant/driver services in a consumer super-app.

candidates.name: Pick Network
candidates.description: Pick Network is an islandwide parcel locker network in Singapore that facilitates delivery and pick-up for e-commerce customers. Users can shop at their online stores or choose a preferred delivery method, ensuring they have the option to lock up their packages at designated locker locations. The service partners with various online merchants and logistics service providers to ensure reliable storage solutions for parcels, allowing users to track their shipments and enjoy convenient access to lockers throughout the process.
candidates.rationale: Pick Network provides parcel-locker infrastructure, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or super-app marketplace evaluated for the same job.

candidates.name: Pelago by Singapore Airlines
candidates.description: Pelago is a travel service that allows users to book activities, attraction tickets, and experiences across various destinations in Asia. The platform offers features such as airport transfers, wellness programs, cruises, food tours, and classes, all accessible through an app for easy management and booking. Users can earn or redeem miles on their bookings and access exclusive benefits, including discounts for memberships and special promotions.
candidates.rationale: Pelago is a travel-activities booking platform, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: InsureGuru
candidates.description: InsureGuru is an online platform that offers a variety of insurance products, including life, health, travel, and mobile equipment insurance. Users can compare policies, manage their policies directly through the platform, and receive personalized assistance from experienced brokers. The service emphasizes data security and provides insights into insurance trends to help users make informed decisions about their needs.
candidates.rationale: InsureGuru is an insurance comparison and brokerage platform, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Enterprise Singapore
candidates.description: Enterprise Singapore is a government agency that provides support and resources for businesses looking to expand or innovate. Its main functionalities include offering financial assistance, talent development programs, and industry-specific advice across various industries such as agriculture, healthcare, and technology. Key features include business entry support, energy efficiency grants, trade insights, and access to specialized networks for innovation and collaboration. The organization also facilitates international trade initiatives and promotes sustainability through its dedicated centers of innovation.
candidates.rationale: Enterprise Singapore is a government business-support agency, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: ManyChef
candidates.description: ManyChef is a food ordering platform that connects customers with independent chefs, bakers, and food artisans in Singapore. Users can browse menus by cuisine or chef, schedule orders for delivery or pickup up to 30 days ahead, and choose the delivery or self-pickup date and time based on their preferences. The platform operates 24/7 and allows kitchens to manage their own order schedules without markups or extra fees, ensuring transparency and customer satisfaction.
candidates.rationale: ManyChef’s food-ordering marketplace with delivery and pickup overlaps Grab’s food-delivery platform and serves the same diners and food merchants.

candidates.name: EasyParcel SG
candidates.description: EasyParcel is a courier service that allows users to send and receive parcels quickly and efficiently, primarily from Singapore. It offers features such as integration with various marketplaces like TikTok and Lazada, instant shipping quotes, and a range of packaging materials in one place. Users can book deliveries online or via phone, ensuring secure and efficient shipping for their orders. The platform also provides tools for tracking shipments and managing regulations related to shipping costs.
candidates.rationale: Both provide online parcel-delivery booking and tracking for consumers and merchants, creating overlap with Grab’s delivery services and users.

candidates.name: Giftano
candidates.description: Giftano is an online platform that offers a wide range of gift products, including gift cards, experiences, flowers, and hampers, primarily for various occasions such as birthdays, Valentine's Day, and corporate events. Users can purchase digital or physical gifts from over 250 brands, with the option to send them via email or through WhatsApp. The service provides flexible delivery options, allowing users to choose between in-store pickup or home delivery, and features a selection of personalized gift options tailored to different recipients.
candidates.rationale: Giftano is a gift marketplace, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or super-app platform serving the same core jobs and buyers.

candidates.name: Deliveroo
candidates.description: Deliveroo is a delivery service that offers food, groceries, pharmacies, and gifts to customers in various cities across the UK. Users can browse a wide range of cuisines and place orders directly through the Deliveroo app or website. The platform allows for easy order tracking, customizable meal deals, and options for gift cards. Additionally, it provides services for work-related deliveries, such as team lunches and student meals, along with promotional discounts on selected items.
candidates.rationale: Deliveroo’s on-demand food and grocery delivery marketplace overlaps Grab’s delivery platform and serves the same consumers, merchants, and couriers.

candidates.name: Benefit Share
candidates.description: Share is a mobile app that helps users discover local deals, earn rewards, and connect with a community of local businesses. Users can browse personalized vouchers for various activities, including food, beauty, and wellness, based on their preferences. The app allows users to earn points by checking in daily, completing missions, and sharing reviews, which can be redeemed for exclusive deals or gift vouchers. Key features include location-based recommendations, a rewards hub for easy access to discounts, and the ability to share experiences and earn commissions through social interaction.
candidates.rationale: Benefit Share is a consumer deals and rewards app, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or financial-services platform.

candidates.name: EveryDeal Hub
candidates.description: EveryDeal Hub is a travel service that helps users find and book affordable flights, hotels, and travel deals worldwide. It offers features such as booking airport transfers, tours to various destinations, and rental services for scooters and bikes. Users can explore special offers, plan their trips, and access travel-related resources all in one platform. The hub also provides options for secure payment methods and customer support for travelers.
candidates.rationale: EveryDeal Hub is a travel-booking aggregator, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Takeaway Voucher Ltd.
candidates.description: Takeaway Voucher is a mobile app that provides users with access to local takeaways directly through their own vouchers. Users can search for deals, choose from various meal options, and place orders by connecting with independent takeaways to receive daily offers without any middlemen or extra fees. The platform aims to make food ordering more affordable while supporting small businesses in the community and enhancing local economies.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer-facing local food-ordering platforms connecting diners with independent restaurants, serving overlapping consumers and merchant partners.

candidates.name: Yofoodie
candidates.description: Yofoodie is a food ordering platform that supports local restaurants by allowing customers to order meals for delivery or table booking. It offers commission-free options, enabling businesses to save on commissions compared to major delivery platforms like JUST EAT, Deliveroo, and Ubereats. Customers can earn rewards such as cash back on their orders and enjoy the same food while benefiting from lower rates and more profits. The platform also provides opportunities for self-employed riders to work remotely, enhancing the overall experience for local businesses.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer food-ordering and delivery marketplaces connecting restaurants, customers, and riders, with overlapping merchant-service and delivery use cases.

candidates.name: Optimise Media Group Limited
candidates.description: Optimise is an affiliate marketing platform that connects brands with a network of over 1,000 partners worldwide to enhance their partner marketing campaigns. The platform offers tools for advertisers to create and manage partnerships across various marketplaces, including retail, finance, and travel markets, while also providing reporting and compliance services to improve campaign performance. Key features include a centralized dashboard for tracking partner interactions, automated payment processing, and tailored solutions for both brands and publishers to drive sales and optimize partnership strategies.
candidates.rationale: Optimise is an affiliate marketing platform, not a consumer super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, payments, and related marketplace services.

candidates.name: Metrobank
candidates.description: Metrobank is a banking service in the Philippines that offers personal, business, and wealth management solutions. Its main functionalities include account opening, loan applications, online deposits, and financial education. Users can manage their finances through the Metrobank App, which allows for bill payments and instant communication with loved ones. The bank also provides various investment options and promotes self-service services to enhance financial literacy.
candidates.rationale: Metrobank is a traditional bank, not a super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, and integrated merchant marketplace services.

candidates.name: Liwas
candidates.description: Liwas is a mobile platform that offers various delivery services across multiple cities in India. It allows users to shop for groceries, order meals from local restaurants, and send urgent parcels securely. Additionally, Liwas provides taxi services for convenient city travel and online shopping options for both businesses and consumers. Users can manage their deliveries through the app, receive real-time discounts, and earn income by selling products or services.
candidates.rationale: Liwas combines app-based taxi rides, food and grocery delivery, and parcel services, overlapping Grab’s core super-app offerings and consumer use cases.

candidates.name: FindTheLoan
candidates.description: FindTheLoan.com is a platform that helps users find loans tailored to their needs, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). It provides a straightforward application process where borrowers can compare offers from multiple lenders in one dashboard, ensuring transparency and trust. Key features include access to competitive interest rates, the ability to review loan reviews, and tools for tracking working capital and operational costs. The service aims to save users time and reduce fees associated with traditional loan brokers by offering an unbiased experience.
candidates.rationale: FindTheLoan is an SME loan-comparison marketplace, not a super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, payments, and integrated financial services.

candidates.name: Pickup.ph
candidates.description: Pickup.ph is an online ordering and delivery platform designed for retail businesses in the Philippines. It allows users to create customized branded online stores with professional templates, manage payments, and utilize auto-hailing for delivery services. Key features include a loyalty program, analytics for customer engagement, third-party integrations, and tools for managing promotions and marketing efforts effectively. The platform aims to simplify the ordering process while providing valuable insights into customer behavior and business performance.
candidates.rationale: Pickup.ph is a merchant storefront SaaS, not a consumer ride-hailing and delivery marketplace; its model and primary buyer proposition differ from Grab.

candidates.name: ShopeeFood
candidates.description: ShopeeFood is an online food delivery service that allows users to order meals from a wide selection of over 1,000 restaurants through the ShopeeFood app. Users can easily select their preferred restaurant, add items to their cart, confirm their delivery address, and complete their orders using various payment methods. The platform also offers promotions for discounted prices on selected meals and provides a community hub for merchants to connect and share updates.
candidates.rationale: ShopeeFood’s restaurant delivery marketplace directly overlaps GrabFood, serving the same consumers and restaurant merchants for on-demand meal ordering and fulfillment.

candidates.name: Uber
candidates.description: Uber is a transportation service that offers ride-based and food delivery solutions across various cities in the United States. Its main functionalities include providing rides, car rentals, grocery deliveries, and business management for companies of any size. Users can schedule rides up to 90 days in advance, manage their accounts, and access safety features through the Uber app. The platform also allows businesses to streamline operations and enhance customer experiences through tailored services and technology.
candidates.rationale: Uber directly overlaps Grab in app-based ride-hailing and delivery, serving the same consumers, drivers, merchants, and business transportation buyers.

candidates.name: Edge Insurance Brokers LLC
candidates.description: Edge Insurance Brokers is an insurance brokerage that offers a variety of insurance products for individuals, businesses, and institutions. Their main functionality includes providing tailored insurance solutions such as personal accident coverage, health insurance, home insurance, and employee benefits. Key features include claims assistance, easy policy quotes, and the ability to manage risks effectively, ensuring clients receive comprehensive protection against unexpected events.
candidates.rationale: Edge is an insurance brokerage, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app like Grab.

candidates.name: SMRT Corporation
candidates.description: SMRT Corporation is a public transport service provider in Singapore that offers trains and buses for both private and commercial users. Its main functionality includes providing reliable transportation solutions, such as rail services, community mobility programs, and smart home integration. Key features include a dedicated journey planner, fare calculator, assistance and claims resources, and a commitment to sustainability and accessibility. The company also emphasizes community engagement through volunteering and volunteer opportunities.
candidates.rationale: SMRT operates scheduled public transit, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, and merchant-services marketplace like Grab.

candidates.name: PWA Marketplace
candidates.description: PWA Marketplace is a platform that offers a curated collection of Progressive Web Applications (PWAs) that can be installed directly from your browser without needing to visit an app store. Users can explore various categories such as productivity, finance, health, education, and more, all designed for easy access across devices. The marketplace also allows developers to submit their apps for consideration, providing a platform for both new and existing PWA applications. Key features include advanced developer tools and a wide range of over 300 apps available for purchase, catering to diverse user needs in areas like AI, travel, and social media.
candidates.rationale: PWA Marketplace is an app discovery/distribution platform, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Geolah Pte. Ltd.
candidates.description: Geolah is a 24/7 mobility app that allows users to book rides and send parcels through a single integrated platform. It connects consumers with private cars while reducing reliance on private vehicles. Key features include transparent pricing, job opportunities for drivers, and various promotions and rewards for both customers and drivers. The app aims to enhance public transport connectivity and improve the overall experience of transportation.
candidates.rationale: Geolah’s on-demand ride-hailing and parcel-delivery marketplace overlaps Grab’s core mobility and delivery offerings for the same consumers, drivers, and merchants.

candidates.name: MemberBuy
candidates.description: memberBuy is a platform that connects customers with local businesses in their communities to find and redeem loyalty rewards. Users can browse through exclusive deals, pay instantly using a mobile app, and present QR codes for redeeming offers. The service also provides real-time alerts about local promotions and allows merchants to manage their own listings without the need for paper cards or stamps. Members buy only when they are shopping locally, promoting community support and savings.
candidates.rationale: MemberBuy is a local loyalty and promotions platform, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or financial-services super-app serving the same job.

candidates.name: OnDrive
candidates.description: OnDrive is an on-demand ride booking app that connects riders with vetted drivers for various rides. Users can book trips up to seven days in advance and choose from economy, premium, or shared options tailored to their preferences. The app offers real-time tracking of rides, transparent pricing without hidden fees, and features like a lost item detection system and the ability to earn income by driving. Additionally, OnDrive provides opportunities for individuals to become drivers, allowing them to set their own schedules and earn fares while ensuring safety and comfort during journeys.
candidates.rationale: OnDrive is an on-demand ride-hailing marketplace connecting riders and drivers, directly overlapping Grab’s core mobility offering and user job to be done.

candidates.name: Amazing Travels
candidates.description: Amazing Travels is a travel booking website that offers a variety of services including flights, hotels, buses, cars, and tours worldwide. Users can search for and book flights at competitive prices, explore hotel packages, and make online payments. The platform also features a mobile app for easy access to transactions and information, along with 24/7 customer support for assistance.
candidates.rationale: Amazing Travels is a travel-booking agency/platform, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Credit Advisor Pte Ltd
candidates.description: Credit Advisor is a platform that helps users find and compare various financial solutions in Singapore, including credit cards, personal loans, travel insurance, savings accounts, and investment options. It provides real-time updates on loan rates, lender reviews, and offers educational content to assist users in making informed financial decisions. The platform has facilitated over 1.06 million transactions and features a comparison tool for multiple banks and insurers to ensure clients receive the best interest rates and benefits.
candidates.rationale: Credit Advisor is a financial-product comparison marketplace, not a super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or directly comparable financial services.

candidates.name: JobXphere
candidates.description: JobXphere is a job search platform that connects job seekers with employment opportunities tailored to their skills and goals. Users can browse over 1,000 listings across various industries, create video profiles for effective resume preparation, and access resources for career advice. The platform also features an referral system where users can refer friends for job openings and receive bonuses when they find suitable positions. Additionally, JobXpheres offers community courses and insights into industry trends to help job seekers enhance their employability.
candidates.rationale: JobXphere is an employment marketplace, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app; its users and jobs-to-be-done differ.

candidates.name: Consumers Connect
candidates.description: Consumers Connect is a platform that offers a variety of contests and giveaways for participants to engage in. Users can participate in different categories, including gift cards, product testing, and surveys, allowing them to vote on prizes or provide feedback to improve their products. The site aims to create memorable experiences while fostering community engagement among consumers and brands.
candidates.rationale: Consumers Connect is a contests and consumer-engagement platform, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Playbot Pro
candidates.description: Playbot Pro is a WhatsApp automation tool designed to enhance marketing, sales, and customer support for businesses. It allows users to create chatbots that automate conversations with customers through voice commands or messaging apps like WhatsApp. Key features include lead capture, contact management, automated reminders, integration with existing systems, and the ability to manage multiple communication flows within a single platform. The service supports various industries such as healthcare, education, hospitality, retail, and more, enabling businesses to streamline operations and improve customer engagement.
candidates.rationale: Playbot Pro is a B2B messaging automation tool, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app serving the same job.

candidates.name: Grab N Go Express
candidates.description: Grab N Go Express is a food service that offers fresh, chef-prepared meals available 24/7 through its freeze-dried options. Customers can access chef-crafted meals prepared by professional chefs, which are stored for up to 25 years without losing flavor or nutrition. The meals come in lightweight and portable formats, making them suitable for various dietary needs, including vegan, gluten-free, and budget-friendly options. Users can easily prepare their meals online using just water and add it to their cart or fridge with the option to pay via cryptocurrency.
candidates.rationale: Grab N Go Express sells packaged meals, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: HudHud
candidates.description: Hud is a delivery and mobility platform that offers a range of services including groceries, taxi rides, courier services, and home repair. It allows customers to place orders from various vendors, request taxis for affordable transportation, and manage food deliveries through a single app. Key features include real-time tracking of deliveries, automated rider assignments, customizable meal programs, and integrated payment options, all designed to streamline operations for businesses and enhance customer experiences.
candidates.rationale: HudHud similarly combines on-demand ride-hailing, food/grocery delivery, courier services, and integrated payments in a single mobility and delivery platform.

candidates.name: FWD Singapore Pte. Ltd.
candidates.description: FWD Singapore is an online insurance company that offers a variety of life and health insurance products, including term life, accident, home insurance, and investment insurance. The main functionality of the website allows users to manage their policies, make claims, and access support through a dedicated claims assessor. Key features include 24/7 customer service, easy renewal options, and promotional promotions for various insurance products. Users can also find advice on coverage options and receive assistance from advisors throughout the insurance process.
candidates.rationale: FWD is an online insurance carrier, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app serving the same user need.

candidates.name: SingPost
candidates.description: SingPost is a Singapore postal service that offers mail and parcel management services for individuals and businesses. It provides options for sending and receiving parcels within Singapore, as well as secure delivery solutions for moving or missed deliveries. Key features include real-time tracking of shipments, customizable postage rates, and a mobile app for managing deliveries on the go. Additionally, SingPost offers various services such as mail retention, redirection, and packaging materials to support diverse shipping needs.
candidates.rationale: SingPost is a traditional postal and parcel carrier, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Border Bank
candidates.description: Border Bank offers a range of banking services including home loans, personal loans, savings accounts, credit cards, and internet banking. Its main functionality is to provide customers with the ability to manage their finances through various financial products such as transaction accounts, savings plans, investment options, and insurance products. Key features include competitive interest rates on savings accounts and term deposits, mobile banking access, and specialized loan programs for both individuals and businesses. The bank also emphasizes community engagement and support through resources like a lost or stolen card service and newsletters.
candidates.rationale: Border Bank is a traditional bank, not a super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, and an integrated merchant-services ecosystem.

candidates.name: Grab3
candidates.description: Grab3 is an online store that offers a variety of clothing and accessories, including t-shirts, hats, and jackets. The main functionality of the website allows users to browse and purchase items directly from the catalog. Key features include a search function by country or region, options for different currencies, and a shopping cart for easy checkout.
candidates.rationale: Grab3 is a clothing e-commerce store, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Deliver Nearby
candidates.description: Deliver Nearby is a local delivery service that connects merchants with independent drivers for various types of deliveries. Users can create deliver requests, schedule deliveries, and benefit from real-time tracking and affordable pricing. The platform supports multiple industries, including grocery, food, and e-commerce, and offers fully insured services for goods during transit. Drivers can register online or via mobile app, manage their accounts, and access customer support through the website.
candidates.rationale: Both operate on-demand local delivery platforms connecting merchants or users with independent drivers, serving overlapping delivery and logistics needs.

candidates.name: OnTrip
candidates.description: OnTrip is a travel management app designed to streamline the booking process for trips across India. It offers features such as real-time driver details, detailed itineraries, and support for airport pickups, allowing users to manage their bookings and expenses in one place. The app also includes curated guides, 24/7 customer support, currency conversion, and options for stickers to enhance photos during trips. Users can access all necessary information and services related to travel planning and safety.
candidates.rationale: OnTrip is a travel-planning and booking companion, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services platform like Grab.

candidates.name: Movve
candidates.description: Movve is a mobile app that offers ride-hailing, package delivery, and food delivery services in Africa. Users can book rides quickly with real-time tracking of drivers and clear pricing, as well as send packages for fast delivery. The platform also provides business solutions for drivers to earn flexible schedules and increase their earnings while ensuring transparency and safety in the service.
candidates.rationale: Movve directly overlaps Grab’s core ride-hailing and delivery marketplace offerings, serving the same riders, senders, merchants, and drivers.

candidates.name: OoNt Services LTD
candidates.description: OoNt is a platform that offers same-day grocery delivery services. Users can shop online from a variety of products, including electronics and fashion, through their mobile app. The service includes real-time order updates, easy order management with drivers, and options for local or national delivery. Additionally, OoNt provides logistics support to optimize deliveries and ride services to city destinations.
candidates.rationale: OoNt overlaps Grab’s on-demand delivery and urban ride services, serving consumers seeking app-based local transport and commerce fulfillment.

candidates.name: Task2bid
candidates.description: Task2Bid is a local service marketplace that connects users with various service providers for tasks. Users can post tasks, browse available services, and filter by type or budget. The platform offers features such as 24/7 customer support, secure payment options, and a public profile for each job listing. It aims to simplify the process of finding and completing tasks while providing opportunities for individuals to earn income through their skills.
candidates.rationale: Task2Bid brokers local freelance tasks, not ride-hailing or delivery; users would not evaluate it against Grab for the same job.

candidates.name: Deliverect
candidates.description: Deliverect is a digital ordering platform designed for restaurants, retail, and delivery businesses. It streamlines operations by centralizing order management, menu optimization, and real-time tracking across various channels such as online, mobile apps, and loyalty programs. Key features include a centralized system for managing orders, logistics, and customer experience, as well as integration with over 1,000 third-party systems to enhance efficiency and profitability. The platform also offers tools for revenue protection, real- time monitoring, and personalized promotions to improve overall customer engagement.
candidates.rationale: Deliverect provides restaurant order-management SaaS, not Grab’s consumer ride-hailing and delivery marketplace; buyers use them for different jobs.

candidates.name: Paycon Technology Inc.
candidates.description: Paycon offers a range of products designed to enhance order collection and fulfillment for retail businesses. Their main functionalities include picking terminals, e-commerce delivery platforms, and a custom picking app that allows customers to place orders without manual intervention. Key features include zero error in picking processes, integration with various payment systems like PayPal and Shopcart, and the ability to manage multiple locations efficiently.
candidates.rationale: Paycon provides retail order-picking and fulfillment software, not Grab’s consumer ride-hailing, delivery marketplace, payments, or super-app model.

candidates.name: Changi Airport
candidates.description: The website provides information and services related to travel at Changi Airport, including flight information, airport terminals, and various travel options such as airlines and hotels. It offers resources for travelers, including immigration clearance, baggage services, and transportation options like sea and land transfers. Users can also find details about attractions, dining, and events in Singapore, as well as access to a rewards program called the Changi Rewards that allows members to earn points on flights and purchases. The site features guides for different cities and destinations, making it easier for users to plan their trips and enjoy amenities like free tours and rest areas.
candidates.rationale: Changi Airport operates airport facilities and traveler information services, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Good Doctor
candidates.description: Good Doctor is a telehealth service that provides patients with access to medical consultations and health services online. It connects users with general practitioners, specialists, and pharmacies across Indonesia for various healthcare needs, including vaccinations, physical appointments, and preventive health programs. The platform also offers business solutions such as health administration tools and custom insurance benefits to enhance patient engagement and streamline healthcare delivery.
candidates.rationale: Good Doctor is a telehealth platform, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app serving the same core job.

candidates.name: QBANK
candidates.description: QBANK is a member-owned banking institution in Queensland that offers a range of financial services including personal loans, car and home insurance, savings accounts, and various digital wallets. Its main functionality is to provide customers with access to competitive rates, flexible loan options, and specialized insurance products for home and vehicle needs. Key features include online banking, mobile payment solutions, fraud prevention resources, and community support initiatives aimed at social responsibility and sustainability.
candidates.rationale: QBANK is a traditional member-owned bank, not a super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, and integrated merchant ecosystem services.

candidates.name: Ubank
candidates.description: Ubank is a financial institution that offers banking services including savings accounts, home loans, and investment options. Its main functionality includes providing users with access to multiple financial products tailored for everyday spending, bills, and home investments. Key features include no monthly fees on accounts, a mobile app for budgeting and managing expenses, high interest rates on savings accounts and loans, as well as personalized support from local banks for loan applications and portfolio management.
candidates.rationale: Ubank is a traditional digital bank, not a super-app offering ride-hailing, delivery, merchant services, and integrated payments.

candidates.name: Dropdrinx
candidates.description: Dropdrinx is a platform that provides e-commerce solutions for food, grocery, parcel, and pharmacy delivery. It offers six modules designed to support various business functions, allowing vendors to create online shops and manage deliveries efficiently. Users can place orders through the Dropdrinx app or website, track their shipments, and earn income by renting vehicles. The platform also supports payment options like PayPal and Klarna, making it suitable for both individual sellers and businesses looking to expand their offerings.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer ordering and delivery platforms for food, groceries, parcels, and merchants, with overlapping users and commerce use cases.

candidates.name: Wexo Innovation Pvt Ltd.
candidates.description: Wexo is a delivery service that provides fast and convenient options for food, grocery, pharmacy products, and parcel deliveries. Users can find local restaurants, order fresh groceries, and send parcels instantly to their city. The platform allows businesses to manage their delivery services through a dedicated app, enabling them to expand their reach and earn rewards through partnerships with over 1,200 local partners.
candidates.rationale: Wexo overlaps Grab’s core on-demand delivery marketplace, serving consumers ordering food, groceries, and parcels while providing merchant delivery tools.

candidates.name: askPepper
candidates.description: askPepper is a platform that provides order, tip, and payment solutions for restaurants and cafes. It allows customers to place orders online using various payment methods like Apple Pay, Visa, and Mastercard, while also offering features such as real-time performance tracking, customer feedback, and easy bill splitting. The service integrates with social media platforms like Instagram, Google, and WhatsApp, enabling businesses to enhance their revenue and improve customer experiences.
candidates.rationale: askPepper provides restaurant ordering and payment software, not Grab’s consumer ride-hailing, delivery marketplace, or super-app model.

candidates.name: BoxKuBox
candidates.description: BoxKuBox is a platform that offers groceries, package delivery, rides, and short stays in Uganda. Users can order groceries online, send packages, book rides for transportation, and manage their stays through an intuitive dashboard. The service provides reliable delivery options with a network of riders to ensure timely and safe service. Additionally, BoxKuBox partners with businesses to expand their reach and access to customers across multiple areas in Uganda, including the Entebbe Road area.
candidates.rationale: BoxKuBox is a multi-service consumer platform offering ride-hailing and delivery, overlapping Grab’s core services and serving similar users and merchants.

candidates.name: JustOrder
candidates.description: JustOrder is a delivery service that offers a variety of products and services, including grocery shopping, food ordering, pharmacy deliveries, car rentals, and online store management. Users can easily order items such as fresh fruits and vegetables, meal options like pizza and shawarma, and vehicle rental options. The platform provides real-time tracking for orders, flexible delivery systems, and the ability to manage multiple stores from one interface. Additionally, JustOrder supports sellers by offering tools for managing their operations efficiently.
candidates.rationale: JustOrder’s multi-category ordering, delivery, tracking, and merchant-management platform overlaps Grab’s food/grocery delivery marketplace and merchant-services offerings.

candidates.name: HSBC Bank (Singapore) Limited
candidates.description: HSBC Singapore offers a range of financial services including personal banking, wealth management, investment options, and credit cards. Its main functionalities include opening various types of accounts (such as global accounts and fixed deposits), providing loans and mortgages for home equity and travel, and offering digital banking solutions like mobile banking and online wallets. The bank also features specialized products like the Wealth Planner for financial planning, which helps users create personalized financial plans based on their needs.
candidates.rationale: HSBC is a traditional bank; it does not offer Grab’s core ride-hailing, delivery, or on-demand super-app marketplace services.

candidates.name: Fomorre
candidates.description: Fomorre is a personalized concierge service in Singapore that helps users plan and explore local experiences. It offers an AI-powered assistant that generates curated itineraries for romantic dates, dining, and social events, allowing users to discover unique locations and activities tailored to their preferences. Members receive access to insider guides, elegant invitations, and exclusive content, all designed to enhance the overall experience of exploring Singapore.
candidates.rationale: Fomorre is an itinerary and local-experience concierge, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Capital Drive
candidates.description: Capital Drive is a trip management software designed for independent chauffeurs and fleet operators. It offers a user-friendly interface that simplifies the booking process, allowing users to manage bookings, payments, and customer interactions efficiently. Key features include automated payment processing, customizable travel information, and integration with major transportation services like airlines and tour operators. The platform aims to help businesses grow by providing tools for efficient operations and reducing stress in their operations.
candidates.rationale: Capital Drive sells operational booking software to chauffeur fleets, not an on-demand ride-hailing marketplace or consumer super-app like Grab.

candidates.name: DriveU MOBILITY SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED
candidates.description: DriveU is an on-demand chauffeur service that connects customers with professional drivers for various transportation needs, including airport runs and in-city trips. Users can easily book a driver through the DriveU app, which offers transparent pricing and background-verified drivers. The platform also provides additional services such as car servicing, maintenance, and event planning, catering to both individual travelers and businesses looking for efficient vehicle management.
candidates.rationale: DriveU offers app-based, on-demand driver booking, overlapping Grab’s core mobility marketplace and serving consumers seeking convenient urban transportation.

candidates.name: DriverPartners.net
candidates.description: DriverPartners.net is a platform that connects drivers, vendors, and fleet operators for rideshare services and vehicles. It allows drivers to register as vendor partners, access exclusive discounts, and resources tailored for both full-time and part-time drivers working with platforms like Uber, Lyft, and Grab. Key features include vehicle leasing programs, fuel card discounts, health and wellness benefits, and support for career development through advice, training, and networking events. The network aims to enhance the profitability of driver work by facilitating collaboration among over 20,000 independent service providers worldwide.
candidates.rationale: DriverPartners supports rideshare drivers with leasing and benefits; it does not operate a consumer ride-hailing, delivery, or super-app marketplace like Grab.

candidates.name: Delivertoo
candidates.description: Delivertoo is a delivery service that offers on-demand solutions for businesses such as restaurants, supermarkets, and e-commerce platforms. It allows users to schedule deliveries directly from their websites or physical locations, with real-time monitoring of the process from receipt to delivery. Key features include customizable delivery options, integration with various transport methods (bikes, motorcycles, and cars), and tools for managing orders and customer returns efficiently. The platform aims to streamline delivery processes and enhance customer satisfaction through flexible scheduling and management.
candidates.rationale: Both provide on-demand delivery platforms for merchants, with overlapping logistics, order-management, and last-mile delivery needs.

candidates.name: Dollar Bureau
candidates.description: Dollar Bureau is a personal finance resource that provides information and advice on various financial products, including insurance, investments, and financial planning. The website offers articles and calculators to help users understand their options and make informed financial decisions. Key features include guides on investment strategies, retirement plans, health insurance, and estate planning, as well as insights into the best brokerage accounts and investment vehicles in Singapore. Users can also access case studies and receive personalized financial advice through licensed advisors.
candidates.rationale: Dollar Bureau is a personal-finance content and advisory resource, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Letschop
candidates.description: Letschop is a platform that connects users with local chefs and vetted kitchens to offer fresh, home-made meals. Users can browse menus, book private chefs for events, and create meal pools for team members or friends. The service also allows cooks to earn money by creating online menus and managing their cooking businesses, while group purchases allow for discounted food items. Additionally, Letschop features a mobile app for easy ordering and community engagement in food.
candidates.rationale: Both operate consumer food-ordering marketplaces connecting diners with local meal providers, overlapping Grab’s food-delivery offering and customer job to be done.

candidates.name: TwalaMeals
candidates.description: TwalaMeals is a food delivery service that connects customers with local restaurants for fast delivery of meals, groceries, and other grocery items. Users can browse over 10,000 restaurants, place orders online or through their TwalaMeALS app, which offers exclusive deals, discounts, and 24/7 customer support. The platform emphasizes quality, convenience, and affordability, ensuring that all orders are made from fresh ingredients and delivered within 30 minutes or less. Additionally, Twala meals supports local businesses by offering flexible delivery options and exclusive perks.
candidates.rationale: TwalaMeals operates an app-based restaurant and grocery delivery marketplace, directly overlapping Grab’s core on-demand delivery offering and customer use case.

candidates.name: LevelUp SG Pte Ltd.
candidates.description: LevelUp.sg is a learning platform in Singapore that offers a variety of courses aimed at upskilling professionals in technology, business, and design. The platform provides over 500 premium courses with curated curriculums covering topics such as full stack development, UI/UX design, and business analytics. Additionally, LevelUp.SG offers expert mentorship from industry leaders, career support including interview preparation, and connections to hiring partners. The courses are recognized by employers and aim to prepare students for job opportunities in the digital age.
candidates.rationale: LevelUp is an online professional education platform, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Speed Credit Pte Ltd.
candidates.description: Speed Credit is a car financing company in Singapore that offers various loan options including new, used, and refinancing for cars and commercial vehicles. Their main functionality is to provide competitive interest rates and flexible repayment plans tailored to individual needs, particularly for those who want to buy or sell their vehicles. Key features include free consultations, fast processing of applications, and access to a wide range of banks and financial institutions across the country.
candidates.rationale: Speed Credit provides vehicle financing, not Grab’s core on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-platform services; buyers and jobs differ.

candidates.name: ManyHands
candidates.description: ManyHands is a platform designed to help small and medium-sized businesses grow their online presence through automation. It offers features such as website building, mobile app development, appointment scheduling, digital marketing, and analytics tools for order control and delivery management. Users can create tailored websites, manage customer loyalty programs, and utilize zero-cost delivery services with drivers for in-house delivery. The platform also provides ongoing support and maintenance to ensure that business operations remain operational and profitable.
candidates.rationale: ManyHands provides SMB website, marketing, and operations software, not a consumer super-app or on-demand ride-hailing/delivery marketplace like Grab.

candidates.name: Scoco Delivery
candidates.description: Scoco is a delivery service that allows users to order food, groceries, and essentials through voice commands. Users can browse or search for nearby restaurants and stores, place orders, and track their deliveries in real-time. The platform also offers opportunities for couriers to become partners, enhancing their business operations by providing access to fast delivery options.
candidates.rationale: Scoco operates an on-demand food and grocery delivery marketplace, directly overlapping Grab’s delivery platform for consumers, merchants, and couriers.

candidates.name: HurryAPP
candidates.description: HURRYAPP is a platform that offers delivery, professional services, and e-commerce solutions under one umbrella. It connects customers with drivers for on-demand and scheduled deliveries, providing real-time GPS tracking and route optimization. The marketplace allows users to browse and sell products easily while facilitating transactions between local vendors and retailers. Each app has different subscription plans tailored for businesses looking to manage their delivery needs efficiently.
candidates.rationale: Both operate multi-service marketplaces connecting consumers, merchants, and drivers for on-demand delivery, commerce, and related merchant services.

candidates.name: PostFinance
candidates.description: PostFinance is a financial services provider that offers a range of products and solutions for private customers, business customers, and individuals. Its main functionalities include opening accounts, managing mortgages, providing investment options, and offering insurance products such as life and health insurance. Key features include online banking, mobile payments, calculators for mortgage calculations, and resources for understanding financial risks and investments. PostFinance also provides support through various channels, including phone calls and live chat, to assist clients with their financial needs.
candidates.rationale: PostFinance is a traditional banking and financial-services provider, not a ride-hailing, delivery, and merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: TravelUnited
candidates.description: TravelUnited is an online travel service platform that offers a wide range of services including flights, buses, trains, hotels, car rentals, and road trips. The platform allows users to book multiple destinations, customize travel packages, and access exclusive deals. Key features include 24/7 customer support, automated itineraries, a smart crawling system for efficient booking processes, and the ability to monitor staff performance and manage bookings efficiently. TravelUnited aims to simplify the travel experience for travelers by providing comprehensive options and reliable suppliers.
candidates.rationale: TravelUnited is a travel-booking platform, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app serving the same job.

candidates.name: Klook
candidates.description: Klook is a hotel booking platform that offers discounted rates for various accommodations, including hotels, hostels, and B&Bs. Users can easily search for accommodations based on their destination and check-in/out dates. The platform supports multiple payment methods, provides customer support in 23 languages, and includes features like free cancellation policies and the ability to pay taxes or fees related to service charges. Klook also facilitates online bookings with flexible payment options and guarantees for secure transactions.
candidates.rationale: A hotel-booking platform does not overlap Grab’s core on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services jobs.

candidates.name: DeliveryDriverDirectory
candidates.description: DeliveryDriver directory is a platform that connects local delivery drivers with customers for fast and affordable logistics. It offers job listings across various categories, including household and family transportation, heavy haul services, independent ride-sharing, and company drivers. Users can post jobs, filter listings by category, or create their own listings to enhance visibility in the delivery industry. The site also provides resources such as driver insights and tips to support drivers, helping them improve their efficiency and connect with potential customers.
candidates.rationale: A driver directory and job-listing site is not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Collectiv Sg
candidates.description: Collectiv Sg is an online store that offers a wide range of products for children, pets, and home care. The main functionality of the website includes browsing and purchasing items such as toys, food, health and wellness products, clothing, and tech accessories. Key features include free local shipping on orders over $60, a diverse selection of brands, and options to shop by age or category. Customers can also find promotions and discounts on various products.
candidates.rationale: Collectiv Sg is a retail e-commerce store, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: DriverX Mobile
candidates.description: DriverX Mobile offers AI-powered data plans specifically designed for drivers in the rideshare, delivery, and logistics sectors. Their services include prepaid and postpaid options, telematics and IoT integrations, and 24/7 support to ensure reliable coverage and customer satisfaction. Key features include real-time data alerts for dead zones, faster activation times, and a range of payment options such as cash on delivery or fuel card. DriverX aims to enhance driver experiences by providing tailored solutions that meet their specific needs.
candidates.rationale: DriverX sells telecom data plans to drivers; it does not offer Grab-like ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or marketplace services.

candidates.name: Zipeat
candidates.description: Zipeat is an online platform that allows users to order food for delivery, pick-up, catering, or dine-in from a wide range of restaurants. Users can search for their preferred menu, select the desired quantity and type of meal, and place orders quickly through a network of trusted merchants. The service also offers features like real-time updates on orders and customer satisfaction, ensuring customers receive quality food at home.
candidates.rationale: Zipeat operates a restaurant food-ordering and delivery marketplace, directly overlapping GrabFood for consumers and restaurant merchants.

candidates.name: GrabEat.fr
candidates.description: GrabEat.fr is an online platform that allows users to order meals for pickup at selected restaurants, eliminating the need for in-person pickup. Users can explore local restaurants and place orders in advance, ensuring fresh food is prepared just before they arrive. The service offers secure payment options, a loyalty program with points, and real-time order tracking through a customizable menu. Additionally, it provides detailed statistics and tools for restaurant managers to enhance their operations and increase revenue through a click & collect feature.
candidates.rationale: Both operate restaurant ordering marketplaces with digital payments, tracking, and merchant tools, serving diners and restaurant operators for meal-order fulfillment.

candidates.name: Level Up
candidates.description: Level is a payment platform that enables businesses to accept global credit card and crypto payments seamlessly. It offers features such as real-time settlements, enhanced security with military-grade encryption, and various payment methods including Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and WeChat. The platform supports eCommerce transactions, online travel, and provides tools for managing complex payment flows across over 190 countries, making it suitable for startups and established companies looking to streamline their payment operations.
candidates.rationale: Level Up is a standalone merchant payment processor, not a ride-hailing and delivery super-app; limited payments overlap does not make it comparable.

candidates.name: Finance Now Limited
candidates.description: Finance Now offers a range of loan solutions including personal loans, shopping finance, and business loans tailored for various needs such as car purchases, home renovations, and equipment rentals. The platform provides flexible loan options with interest rates ranging from 8.45% to 29.95%, along with flexible repayment terms ranging from 6 to 60 months. Users can also access credit cards that offer exclusive deals and rewards programs, allowing them to manage their finances more effectively. Additionally, Finance Now supports merchants in New Zealand by offering financing solutions through over 1,500 retail stores across the country.
candidates.rationale: Finance Now is primarily a lending and retail-finance provider, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, and merchant-services super-app like Grab.

candidates.name: Auto Europe
candidates.description: Car2Car is a car rental platform that allows users to compare and book vehicles for hire across various regions in Europe, North America, and the Caribbean. The website offers a wide range of car options, including luxury cars, minibuses, electric vehicles, and camper rentals, catering to different budgets and preferences. Users can create accounts to manage their booking, search for available vehicles, view pricing, and access exclusive discounts. The platform also provides information on vehicle insurance, financing options, and customer support.
candidates.rationale: Auto Europe is a traditional car-rental comparison and booking platform, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Tr1pp
candidates.description: Tr1pp is a mobile app that offers various financial services including ride-in, international money transfer, and payment solutions. Users can manage their finances through the platform, pay bills online, and access customer support. The app also provides tips for personal finance goals and safety in driving, catering to individuals and businesses looking to enhance their financial literacy. Tr1pp operates globally, with options for local delivery across Africa, Europe, and the Caribbean.
candidates.rationale: Tr1pp is primarily a payments/remittance app; its vague ride and delivery references do not establish Grab-like on-demand marketplaces.

candidates.name: iZoCo
candidates.description: iZoCo is a rental platform in Malaysia that helps users find and manage their homes. It offers an AI-powered matching tool based on individual lifestyles and budgets, facilitating seamless moving for families. Key features include property listings, digital contracts, home care services, and secure payment options, all managed through a single integrated ecosystem. The platform also provides 24/7 assistance from Zoco, ensuring personalized support for its members.
candidates.rationale: iZoCo is a home-rental and property-management platform, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Qantas Airways Limited
candidates.description: Qantas Money is a financial service that offers credit cards, home loans, and travel solutions for both individuals and businesses. Its main functionalities include booking flights, managing flight status, and earning points through various rewards programs. Additionally, Qantas provides insurance products, gift vouchers, and tools for car rentals and online shopping, along with options for home loan applications tailored to customer needs. The platform also features a marketplace for purchasing gifts and travel-related items.
candidates.rationale: Qantas Money is an airline-linked financial and travel service, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, and merchant super-app like Grab.

candidates.name: The Daily Grab
candidates.description: The Daily Grab is an online store that offers a wide range of products across various categories, including camping, electronics, health and wellness, home essentials, men's clothing, pet supplies, and women's clothing. The main purpose of the website is to provide quality items at competitive prices while ensuring fast delivery. Customers can browse through different collections and make purchases directly from the site. Additionally, the store emphasizes affordability and customer service.
candidates.rationale: The Daily Grab is a general online retailer, not a ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or financial-services super-app.

candidates.name: Book A Travel
candidates.description: Book A Travel is a travel and tour booking platform that allows users to find and book flights, hotels, cars, and other travel services. The website offers a wide range of accommodations, including hotels and villas, as well as car rentals with various rental plans tailored for different needs. Users can search for flights by location, check-in options, and make payments using multiple payment methods. Additionally, the site provides information on popular destinations and features customer support through WhatsApp and email.
candidates.rationale: Book A Travel is a travel-booking portal, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, and merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: Hungry Time
candidates.description: Hungry Time is a food delivery service that allows users to order meals from local restaurants directly to their homes. The platform offers a variety of options, including street food and fine dining, along with features like fast delivery, easy payment processing, and 24/7 customer support. Users can also join as deliverymen by registering as delivery men and earn income through the HungryTime app.
candidates.rationale: Hungry Time’s restaurant delivery marketplace overlaps Grab’s core food-delivery offering, serving the same diners, restaurants, and delivery workers.

candidates.name: Seemyticket
candidates.description: Seemyticket.com is an online travel booking platform that offers a variety of services including flights, hotels, buses, cars, and tours. Users can search for and compare prices across multiple destinations, manage bookings, and make payments securely. The site also provides personalized services, 24/7 customer support, and features a mobile app for easy transactions and travel management. Key functionalities include flight tracking, hotel room reservations, and the ability to book cruises and other transportation options.
candidates.rationale: Seemyticket is a travel-booking aggregator, not an on-demand ride-hailing, delivery, payments, or merchant-services super-app.

candidates.name: AdFoodz
candidates.description: AdFoodz is an on-demand food delivery service that supports local businesses by not charging commissions to restaurants and drivers. Users can order food directly from the platform, benefiting from a similar pricing model as in-store. The service allows for individuals who own cars, bikes, or scooters to earn income while providing support through a free monthly fee. Additionally, businesses can list their services without incurring commission fees, enabling them to reach more customers and expand their market reach.
candidates.rationale: AdFoodz operates an on-demand food delivery marketplace connecting restaurants, drivers, and consumers, directly overlapping Grab’s food-delivery offering and user base.

candidates.name: Flute
candidates.description: Flute is a payment processing platform that offers various payment options for businesses, including in-person, mobile, and online transactions. It allows customers to make payments through multiple methods such as contactless devices, QR codes, or point-of-sale systems, while ensuring secure data protection against fraud. Key features include customizable invoicing, recurring billing, dual pricing and surcharging, and instant payouts, all designed to streamline financial management and enhance customer experience across different industries like personal care, food, healthcare, and retail.
candidates.rationale: Flute is a standalone business payment processor, not a consumer super-app or on-demand ride-hailing and delivery marketplace like Grab.

candidates.name: Quickstore
candidates.description: Quickstore is an e-commerce platform that offers a variety of services including food delivery, pharmacy, and grocery shopping. It allows users to manage their daily shopping, order parcels for home delivery, and find deals from local stores. Key features include a flexible delivery system, location tracking, payment options, and the ability to earn income by partnering with multiple vendors. The platform also provides tools for sellers to easily manage their online businesses and enhance customer experiences.
candidates.rationale: Quickstore overlaps Grab’s on-demand food, grocery, and parcel delivery marketplace, serving both local consumers and merchants through payments and seller tools.
